fields.value: Draw a job's later points when one seed's run ended earlier

A report curve draws a job's point only when every seed has that checkpoint, so a job whose seeds stopped at different lengths shows nothing past the shortest. In manabot's tla_trophies_floor (r2://manabot/jobs/tla_trophies_floor, experiment file experiments/tla_trophies_floor.py on branch jack/mtg-408-floor-the-damped-updates-reverse-kl-so-a-locked at 91c601eb30), seed 40901 of each tau arm finished at update 400 and seed 40902 continued to 1,000. Every panel stops at 400, though seed 40902's held-out, half-training and head-to-head games through 900-1000 are recorded.

The documented workaround, seatings with seeds="one", does not work for these benchmarks: panels over the one-seed tournaments render "Tau x2 · 2 seeds: 1 of 2 seeds evaluated" with no points, and Curve panels over the one-seed relative seatings (Fraction / Aligned opponents) emit "A Curve panel names seating 'One-seed tau-x2 deal 7', which nothing holds." for many deals.

Wanted: a seed whose run has finished before a checkpoint is not "not yet evaluated"; the job's point there is drawn from the seeds that reached it and says how many (for example "1 of 2 seeds"). seeds="one" seatings with relative opponents should also draw. Keep a still-running seed's missing checkpoint a gap, as now. Test on this experiment's real records.
